rationale: v1 evaluation showed LCA fine-tuning with weak perturbations (p_drop<=0.03, p_sub<=0.005) does NOT improve robustness (mean robustness_improvement across 12 (L, perturbed_cond) cells and 6 metrics ~= 0). v2 uses ~5x stronger probabilities + an explicit consistency loss to give the model a real robustness signal.
substitution: uniform legal codebook index in [0, K-1]
consistency_loss_definition: When the sampled channel condition is non-clean, additionally decode the same truncated codes WITHOUT ChannelSim, then compute multi-scale mel L1 between the clean decode and the perturbed decode. Added to comm_branch with weight lambda_consistency = 0.5. Triggered ~80% of training steps (4 of 5 conditions are non-clean).
note: channel_sim sampling is independent of L sampling; stats per step are written to metrics/lca_train_metrics.jsonl
